entries.label: AC!D — Ruins Upper 03B / voie des conteneurs
entries.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: one opaque PNG static stage background for a side-on 2D fighting game, target 1672 x 941 pixels, landscape 16:9.
Primary request: reconstruct the UPPER RUINS, Stage 03B, of Metal Gear AC!D (original PSP) as ONE empty lateral combat environment. The supplied gameplay reference sheets are multiple camera views of that location, not an output template. Preserve the actual upper zone's industrial container-and-road identity, which differs from the stone corridors of Ruins Lower.
Environment identity observed in the references: dull military-green corrugated shipping containers with simple double doors, some placed at right angles, dark low metal railings on raised concrete edges, sparse wooden cargo crates and dark cylindrical barrels, worn dark green-brown earth/concrete paving, weathered old masonry retaining surfaces at the back. Two parallel circulation paths around the container obstacles are suggested in depth. Restrained murky olive and brown illumination, subdued gray-green materials; no new skyline or grand architecture.
Composition: mostly lateral camera at human height across a short loading-yard section. Put a long ribbed green container, a second angled container side, and modest cargo stacks behind the playing line, separated by narrow gaps. Keep the full lower quarter continuous, almost level and clear as a dirt/concrete fighting lane. Rear ledges can convey the upper route, but do not create disconnected fighting platforms. It is not a complete reconstruction of the tactical grid.
Style: detailed HD painted 2D game background, faithful subdued original-PSP palette and simple utilitarian shapes. Fine surface wear is a reconstruction; avoid ornate embellishment or bright new lighting. Keep readable silhouettes and a slightly lighter floor.
Constraints: no characters, soldiers, Snake, Teliko, drones, patrol robots, trucks, weapons, projectile effects, lasers or active hazards. No PSP hardware border, gameplay cards, HUD, numbers, text, dialogue, ground grid, target circles, map labels, logos or watermark. No ancient temple, jungle vines consuming the containers, fantasy ruin arches, modern hangar or replacement drawbridge. One opaque image, no panels or collage.
entries.correctionPrompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit only the container door placements in this existing AC!D Upper Ruins background. The broad long side of the large foreground shipping container currently has a small double door in the center; remove that invented door and replace it with uninterrupted matching vertical corrugated military-green metal, continuing the same rib spacing and weathering. Likewise remove the small double door on the long side of the upper rear container and continue that side's vertical corrugation. Shipping-container end doors may remain only if a short end is actually visible. Keep every other aspect unchanged: exact image dimensions, composition, container silhouettes and positions, retaining wall, rear walkway railing, crates, barrels, floor, lighting, palette and texture. Do not add any text, character, objects or graphic border. One opaque PNG.
